phase: Static review before oracle evaluation, numerical examples, test collection/execution, adapter conversions or candidate implementation.
novelty: Strict source-value admission precedes canonical validation and is distinct from completed Portfolio, risk, reporting, strategy-boundary and recovery studies. A source lead remains unconfirmed until the frozen baseline reproduces it.
scope_review: Only strict price_to_ticks and scaled_quantity use the exact coefficient/exponent kernel; the other conversion APIs and literal non-strict arithmetic remain unchanged.
Signed and zero generic prices, positive finite units, quantity positivity/allow_zero and Decimal(str(input)) semantics are preserved.
Combine exponents and cancel integer factors before allocating powers; balanced compact operands must not be expanded independently.
The six fixed profiles and 240 scalar/CSV observations, two existing default-context adapter controls and legacy group are a bounded correctness corpus, not a parameter or performance search.

Full source-tree/import/frozen-input pins, strict canonical certificates, exact ordinary rows/schema/fingerprint/diagnostics/Parquet controls and independent artifact review are appropriate publication gates.
preexecution_bindings: For the frozen CSV template, book_price and book_amount edits apply to the initial BID row whose original price is 1 and amount is 2. This preserves the intended strict-valid false-admission witness rather than introducing an unrelated crossed ask.

Trade cases use the frozen book reduction and trade row; book_zero_update uses the frozen zero-amount update. The test/provider must record the exact generated CSV bytes and parsed strings before conversion.

Create deterministic local context profiles, including the preexisting FloatOperation flag, then compare every context setting/trap/flag before and after each call while preserving the outer caller context.
The independent oracle must use lexical/integer rational reasoning and explicit compact-exponent expectations without production helpers or context-rounded Decimal arithmetic.
limits: LOBSTER price-scale and timestamp preprocessing can round before the repaired helpers and remains unresolved; normal-control equivalence does not establish its general exactness.
Malformed/nonfinite parsing flags, whole-adapter rollback, already-rounded binary64 provenance and unlimited resource/output ranges are outside the stated guarantee.
No market-data rights/admission, causal midpoint identification, calibrated fills, economic advantage or performance improvement is established.
Nasdaq review belongs to the separate worker; this reviewer issued no Nasdaq request.
trial_accounting: One main worker and one candidate worker using the fixed corpus and reused baseline; at most one independently justified correctness repair. Ordinary full-suite and exact-head CI repetitions are separate disclosed verification.
execution_by_reviewer: Source, protocol and fixture text/hash reads only. No numerical example, oracle, conversion, test, engine or outcome evaluation; no source edit. This design-review file is the only requested write.
